fields.title: 📖 Say: Has Allah permitted it to you?
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah rebukes those who declare part of the provision ḥalāl and part ḥarām, and asks: Has Allah permitted it to you, or do you invent a lie against Allah?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever permits and forbids in Allah’s name needs proof. Without proof, Ḥalāl/Ḥarām becomes a lie against Allah.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah Yūnus 10:59.
